entities.name: Clément Dupont
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clément Dupont was a French rugby union player who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was born in Argelès-Gazost and died in Bordeaux. In 1924 he won the silver medal as a member of the French team.
